description: Defines an API endpoint for deleting catalog items in the eShopWeb application. It sets up a DELETE HTTP route, authorizes the caller as an administrator, and implements the handler logic to delete a specific catalog item by ID.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for deleting a catalog item, implementing route registration and request handling logic.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the DELETE route for catalog items with authorization policies.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the delete request, interacts with the repository to delete the specified item, and returns an appropriate HTTP result.
